purpose: Teach: 横目/廻り/突きつけ/交わす/悟っ/総て/浅く/喜ばしい

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが横目でばあさんを見てらしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to look at you out of the corner of his eye.
lines.style: Slow, measured pace. Soft nostalgic tone, as if reaching back decades. Gentle on the memory. Slight pause before speaking, like he's choosing his words carefully from a very old place.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お家の廻りを毎朝歩かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and your grandfather — he'd walk around the house every morning, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, conversational, gently affirming. Light rhythm, like she's building on what he said. A small smile in her voice. The 'dear' is intimate, not performative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは敵に証拠を突きつけられた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father — he faced difficult things with courage.
lines.style: Deliberate, slightly heavier than before. Respect in the tone. Each word weighted. Pause between clauses, like he's honoring the memory. Voice steady but moved.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫さんとお言葉を交わすのを楽しみにされてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And your grandfather, he treasured those moments talking with the grandchildren, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Soft, reflective agreement. She's echoing his reverence now. Gentle rise on the question. No hurry. The voice of someone who lived it and remembers it clearly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは人生の儚さを悟ってらしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father understood how fleeting life truly is.
lines.style: Quiet wisdom. Almost whispered in its tenderness. Slow, deliberate pacing. The tone of someone who has arrived at acceptance. No drama — just truth spoken gently.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様の事を総て可愛がってらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather loved all the grandchildren with his whole heart, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle affirmation, full of quiet warmth. Not wistful — certain. The tone of someone stating something she knows completely. A small sigh of contentment underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんの傷は浅くて命に別状なかった
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father — his wounds were not deep, and his life was never in danger.
lines.style: Careful, reassuring tone. Emphasis on safety, on 'not deep.' Slow, steady delivery. The voice of someone ensuring she understands he was all right. Tender protection in the words.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ばあさんとの再会を喜ばしい気持ちで思って下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather was so happy when he saw you again — that joy stayed with him, didn't it, dear?
lines.style: Warm, intimate close. Light breath on the opening. A lifting quality, like relief and happiness together. Tender on 'dear.' The final word trails slightly, like a goodbye that's also a completion.
